source_evidence_rows.statement: The 2026-09-07 local ranking labels P0162 'Fourier entropy versus total influence' and records status 'attempted_un'.
source_evidence_rows.exact_quote: 5,P0162,Fourier entropy versus total influence,attempted_un,Fourier entropy versus influence conjecture
source_evidence_rows.verdict: KEEP as historical catalog metadata only; current openness and the exact conjecture remain unverified

current_openness: UNKNOWN; May and September 2026 primary papers still call the unrestricted statement a conjecture
exact_statement: There exists an absolute C such that for every n and every Boolean f:{-1,1}^n->{-1,1}, sum_{S subset [n]} hat_f(S)^2 log_2(1/hat_f(S)^2) <= C sum_{S subset [n]} |S| hat_f(S)^2, under the uniform product measure and Fourier-Walsh normalization hat_f(S)=E[f(x) product_{i in S}x_i]. Zero terms contribute zero.
source_for_exact_statement: https://www.cs.cmu.edu/~odonnell/papers/fei.pdf, Introduction, p.2 (author's primary paper restating FK96)
source_quote: Fourier Entropy–Influence (FEI) Conjecture. ∃C ∀f, H[ f̂²] ≤ C · I[f].
original_source: Friedgut and Kalai, Every monotone graph property has a sharp threshold, Proc. AMS 124 (1996), DOI 10.1090/S0002-9939-96-03732-X; original PDF located but its exact conjecture text could not be extracted with the available web tool
scope_caution: The Boolean-valued hypothesis is essential; the same inequality is false for arbitrary real-valued f.
local_special_case: The owner's F0090 files claim FEI for critical percolation crossing events; see prob1000_lean_20260908/f0090_paper/spectral_entropy_crossing.tex:29 and REPORT_F0090_Kalai_conjecture_8_entropy_influence_percolation_2026-09-10.md:74. This does not settle general P0162.
